description: Moon phase and next full moon — Offline lunar calculator: phase name, illumination %, moon age, waxing/waning, days to the next full and new moon, upcoming phase times in UTC (Meeus algorithm, within minutes), traditional full moon name (Wolf, Harvest, Hunters...) and blue moon flag. Optional date (ISO) and count of upcoming phases. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
